prompt_text: What is a good martial arts school for kids in St. Peters MO?
answer_verbatim:
A good place to start is **World Martial Arts Academy** at **1057 Cave Springs Blvd.** It offers age-specific classes for preschoolers (4–5) and kids (6–10), with an emphasis on confidence, focus, and discipline. Its website lists a **14-day trial for $49** and tuition of **$159/month**, with no long-term contract; confirm current pricing and availability before visiting. [Website](https://blackbeltstl.com/)

If your child is more interested in grappling and ground-based self-defense, **Onyx Grappling** is another option. It has separate children’s classes for ages **4–6, 7–9, and 10–12**. [Website](https://onyxgrappling.com/)

I’d visit or try a class at both and see which instructor and class atmosphere your child responds to best.
